errors.evidence: The description identifies the color of the SQLite line as turquoise/blue-green ("тюркоазена/синьо-зелена"). According to the legend and the plot, the line for SQLite is red. The turquoise line represents Cassandra.
The description identifies the color of the Cassandra line as light blue ("светлосиня"). According to the legend and the plot, the Cassandra line is turquoise. The light blue line represents Oracle.
